clips.title: The story
paras: The Dormant Shade is a dark ritual performed at Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. By placing a mystic candle upon an old, blood-soaked table, a traveler summons forth the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara, whose defeat proves to Gunther Arcanus that the visitor is the Lich King's foe.

On the island of Gunther's Retreat in Brightwater Lake rests a battered, bloody dinner table. Far from an ordinary piece of neglected domestic furniture, it serves as the physical focus for a sinister conjuration. Stained with dried gore and abandoned to the shadows, the table acts as a makeshift ritual slab where death and dark magic linger.
